Three full bases piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full and piece:0,1,0;full meet at the junction 0,0|0,1|1,0 carrying the spike

finish.summary: Built a three-base display stand: three full bases (0,0), (1,0) and (0,1) at level 0 meet at one junction, where a mount spike stands trapped through the large platform (platform-lrg). Open faces were capped with solid caps and joints locked with joint bolts. check_build passes with meshClash clear and no issues. No display prop was added: the platform surface is not offered as a prop surface by the configurator, so the stand is left empty and ready to display an item.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

result.note: A spike stands where three bases meet at a corner: place three bases around one junction first. No place on the build takes this part right now.
